articles.title: SJAA Awards and Board Elections 2019
articles.summary: The San Jose Astronomical Association (SJAA) held its 2019 annual meeting, awards ceremony, and board elections on February 16th. Awards were presented to Vini Carter for the Fixit program, Muditha Kanchana for the loaner program, and Carl Wong for the Starry Nights Star Party program, recognizing their exemplary service. Additionally, Vini Carter, Rob Chapman, Ken Miura, Swami Nigam, and Sukhada Palav were re-elected to the Board of Directors.

articles.title: Tour Alien world with new multimedia treats
articles.summary: NASA's Exoplanet Exploration Program (ExEP) has launched new multimedia tools designed to engage the public with exoplanet discovery and characteristics. These releases include a new Exoplanet Travel Bureau poster and 360-degree visualization of the molten world 55 Cancri e, an interactive web feature on the life and death of planetary systems, and a major update to the popular "Eyes on Exoplanets" app. These resources allow users to virtually explore thousands of exoplanets, learn about their environments, and interact with scientific data.

articles.title: All Systems Go As Parker Solar Probe Begins Second Sun Orbit
articles.summary: NASA's Parker Solar Probe successfully completed its first orbit of the Sun on January 19, 2019, and has now begun its second of 24 planned orbits, heading for its next close approach on April 4. The spacecraft is fully operational and has already delivered over 17 gigabits of science data, hinting at new discoveries about the Sun's fundamental physics. The mission team is analyzing this data while preparing for the upcoming solar encounter.

articles.title: SJAA Member Astrophoto Gallery
articles.summary: This article features an astrophotography gallery showcasing deep-sky images captured by members of the San Jose Astronomical Association (SJAA). Each entry provides details about the celestial object photographed, the amateur astronomer, date, location, and the specific imaging equipment and software utilized for each shot. Noteworthy photographs include the Great Orion Nebula, Jellyfish Nebula, NGC 3603, and the Crab Nebula.

articles.title: Kid Spot
articles.summary: This 'Kid Spot' article features astronomy-themed jokes and a quiz on celestial objects like the Pillars of Creation, Alberio, and Pleiades. Additionally, it provides an update on NASA's Curiosity Mars rover, detailing its final selfie on Vera Rubin Ridge before descending into a clay-bearing unit on Mount Sharp to further investigate clues about ancient Martian lakes.

articles.title: From the Board of Directors
articles.summary: The San Jose Astronomical Association (SJAA) announced several new board appointments, including Ken Miura for Stars Over Yosemite and Kaushal Gangakhedkar as Membership Chair, alongside Vikas Kache as Ephemeris Content Editor. Upcoming club activities include a Spring Swap Meet on March 17, 2019, and officer elections for key positions during the March 23 board meeting. The board also discussed plans for joint events, potential affiliation with the Astronomy League, and initiatives to boost membership involvement and fill open positions.

articles.title: SJAA Library
articles.summary: The San Jose Astronomical Association (SJAA) offers a wide array of resources and programs for its members and the community, including a library with astronomy books and DVDs. Programs range from telescope repair sessions, solar and night sky observing events, and beginner-focused Quick STARt and Intro to the Night Sky sessions, to equipment loaners and astrophotography workshops. The SJAA also hosts school star parties to engage the broader community in astronomy.
